name: Dual regime gate + extreme-fear sentiment arms BB-z washout reversion
rationale: THESIS: a bb_z washout armed by the dual macro/vix gate, with a crypto-native sentiment confirmation — fear_greed in extreme-fear (lt a fitted floor, 0-100 BOUNDED) — to require that the dislocation is also a sentiment capitulation, not a quiet technical dip. Three orthogonal lenses: macro (FRED composite), TradFi vol (vix), crypto sentiment (fear_greed), arming a band-relative price trigger. DISCONFIRMER 1 (does fear_greed add over the macro/vix gate?): spec-1 (dual gate + bb_z, no fear_greed) is the baseline. DISCONFIRMER 2 (is fear_greed just a vix proxy?): a sibling dropping the vix gate but keeping fear_greed tests whether crypto sentiment substitutes for TradFi vol or adds to it. DISCONFIRMER 3 (just buy-extreme-fear?): the inbox fear-greed-contrarian control is the ungated baseline. DISCONFIRMER 4 (holdout).
catalyst: fear_greed extreme-fear with a bb_z washout under a risk-on calm-vol regime
